Jonathan Constable Update

By: Harri Vithi | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
The law catches up with a serial conman

Unique Selling Point:
Police effecting an arrest

Summary:
Last week Sunday Carte Blanche broadcast the many scam-tales of a man named Jonathan Constable.

Constable purports to be a pilot, a human rights advocate, a rental property law enforcer and an immigration agent - he's none of the above

His countless alleged victims longed for justice

Soundup:
Luthando, Nomusa, Louis

A day after the show aired, the hands of justice began turning

The owner of this bed & breakfast establishment in Germiston watched Carte Blanche
Viz: B&B
SOUNDUP B&B OWNER
....

Within hours, the producer received a call from the police requesting additional information as they were outside the B & B to effect the arrest.

Constable has an outstanding warrant of arrest relating to pointing a firearm at TUPA employees
VIZ: Louis making gun gesture

VO: We rushed to the location

Viz: tracking shots on highway to Germiston

VO: We arrived at the B &B at the same time as the policy's tactical unit
VIZ....
pick up mobile footage as Harri turns into B&B behind police cars
Police come out of vehicle

VO: On entering the property, had climbed into the ceiling to hide from police

VO: Outside the property Constable’s lawyer argued with police
Viz: lawyer in heated discussion with police

VO: Inside, two bedrooms - to the left and the right...one of them presumably occupied by Constable, where he devised his many reported dodgy schemes
Viz: the rooms

VO:
As we turned down a passage, the police were on a ladder to access the ceiling where Constable had attempted to make an escape

Ironic, Constable - the fake pilot had climbed to greater heights to make a getaway
Viz: Officer on ladder
Soundup: SAPS officer
Come here, I'll shoot you...

We could hear the sound of Constable's feet scurrying across the ceiling floor, then suddenly behind this door - there was a thud
Viz: female officer positions herself and point weapon at the door
Soundup: SAPS OFFICER
Because you are stupid why did you not comply...

VO: Constable had fallen from the ceiling

VIz: Officer trying to trace the room where Constable may have fallen ...knocking on the wall...moves the painting...we follow him outside

VO: Outside a lone female with a vacant look on her face stood silently, we later learnt she's Constable’s "wife"

Viz: we continue to follow the Officer and there stands Constable covered in "soot"

VO:
Here he is - a wanted man for over a year now- finally in handcuffs

Soundup:
Lawyer explains to Constable why he's being arrested - there's a warrant valid till 2027

VO: We can only hope the law will take its course.
Viz: the police car as it drives away with Constable in the back

Nomsa Ninela

HARRI__Jonathan Constable Update.docx
1 / 4
Jonathan Constable Update
VO 1: Last Sunday, we introduced you to Jonathan Constable - a man of many
faces: rental reformer…asylum consultant… pilot?
UPSOUND MONICA BOW (original insert)
Monica Bow, Independent Investigator
@1:27 Monica Bow, Independent Investigator
I can’t see how can you fly a plane if you’re not a pilot…
VO 2: An apparent serial scammer, it’s alleged Constable had many victims.
@02:30 Monica Bow, Independent Investigator(original insert)
…today he's the pilot, tomorrow he's a home affairs official then he's with special training
forces with the cops then he's a CI, he's been everywhere else even in Iraq fighting
VO 3: And when not fighting in distant lands, he claimed to be an immigration
agent of sorts, guaranteeing visas to refugees .
(original insert)
@10:21 Monica Bow, Independent Investigator
30 people were on the group 30 people were conned
VO 4: When masquerading as a rental property slash law enforcer, Constable
allegedly demanded fees for “protecting tenants from fake landlords”. (original
footage)
@08:10 Monica Bow, Independent Investigator (original insert)
He's one of the best hijackers of a hijacked building in South Africa. He cons people.
VO 5: Some of his victims told us Jonathan Constable is nothing more than a
serial conman who’s evaded justice for too long. When he responded to us last
week, Constable denied all of these allegations.
@10:58 Monica Bow
…he was well connected, people are so scared of him - he is well protected - whoever I
contacted in my network knew about Jonathan Constable
Viz: Police officers by a ladder

VO 6: But all that changed after our broadcast when police tracked down the
elusive Constable to a Johannesburg guesthouse. They’d been tipped-off by a
resident who’d watched our story. And slung over a chair, a remnant of his –
ahem – many talents.
Viz: The guesthouse from the street: 22380002 - 22380010
2 / 4
VIZ: tracking shots between guesthouse and airport museum: 22380013 - 22380031
VO 8: The guest house was a short drive from Constable’s pseudo-office – the
SAA Museum where this alleged pilot took these phony pictures.
Splash images of JC across screen: Google Drive - 4. GD JC SS, 7. JC Pilot, 7. Pilot
Pic, Pilot mock shots
Viz: Police entering the gate parking and exiting vehicle
VO 9: Confronted by the long arm of the law, Constable high-tailed it back into the
guesthouse and called his lawyer.
(highlight man in the suit)
SOUNDUP conversation between lawyer and the police
VIZ: Police by the ladder
VO 10: Then, things took a bizarre turn: Constable headed into…. the roof.
Viz door @06:15 “Jonathan Constable Arrest’ _google drive
03:50 “Jonathan Constable Arrest’ _google drive
Jahh he’s here (officer knocks on closed door) – Jonathan says something through the
door -officer responds – jahh coz you’re stupid you were supposed to comply mos jahh
he need help maybe he’s injured
04:20 “Jonathan Constable Arrest’ _google drive
Hey hey – come here come here – I will shoot you come here, come here come here
VO 11:The police had no choice but to head into the roof themselves…

Jahh let’g go all of us
VO 12: …to foil Constable’s planned escape.
VO 13: Then, a moment of drama…

Viz: hole in the ceiling with police struggling to come down
VO14:… as the ceiling gave way, bringing Constable crashing back to earth.
08:40 Constable’s lawyers voice -(please subtitle)
3 / 4
They said it’s Booysens, there was a warrant issued it’s expiring 2027 so that’s the
reason why you’ve been arrested, we don’t have the physical warrant as yet
VO 14: Constable was arrested for failing to appear in court on a charge relating to
pointing a firearm.
VIZ: Louis gesturing as if pointing gun (6:22)
O8:50 Male police officer (Harri asked to stop recording)
…can you stop…
Constable's lawyers say no warrant of arrest was provided by police
VIZ: police cars speeding away with Constable in the back
VO 15: One of Constable’s alleged victims couldn’t hide her relief.
Viz: Nomusa Ninela walking up stairs to plane
VO 16: For now, Constable has a new B&B in the form of Johannesburg’s Sun City
Prison.
SOUNDUP Nomusa Ninela
22380037 - new interview on plane
01:26 Nomusa Ninela
At least he will feel the pain I felt the time I was arrested because of him so I'm very
happy
VO 17: Nomusa Ninela once worked for Constable. She claims he orchestrated her
arrest on a trumped up charge after daring to demand her salary… spending a
week in prison for her troubles. Constable denies his involvement in her arrest.
FX6_0880 - (original insert)
07:34 Nomusa Ninela
… it was not easy asking myself what did I do? SunCity is cold I’ve never experienced
Sun City in my life - for 7 days for seven days without brushing your teeth without doing
anything without using a toiletries, without using a soap to bath. 7 days for something
that I didn’t do… Jonathan and his crew, they need to pay - they need to pay big time

VO 19: While his alleged victims wondered about his whereabouts, Constable
would post blurry images like these on his Whatsapp status – having fun in the
pool at the very guesthouse where he made his last stand.
Viz: video of the pool
UPSOUND NOMUSA NINELA
4 / 4
22380037 - new interview on plane
04:02 Nomusa Ninela
I wish that was his last time for him swimming…
04:30 Nomusa Ninela
He scared people, he threatened people - he destroyed people's lives
*please blur all police officers faces
VO 20: Constable will be back in court early next week..
